voiceScript: Remembering one strong password is safer than reusing one everywhere. Password Managers means tools that create and store a different strong password for every account behind one master password. Picture this: one reused shopping password leaks and criminals try it on email and social accounts. Here is why that matters: a single breach can unlock several accounts when passwords are reused. Choose a reputable manager and a long master password. Replace reused passwords, starting with email and banking. Click the Follow button to see new cybersecurity tips every day.
